info.title: Somaris API
info.description: Somaris exposes read-only SOMA V2 advertisement telemetry and asynchronous, idempotent open, close, stop, percentage-position, and toggle commands for enrolled blinds. Physical discovery uses manufacturer advertisements; control resolves a fresh unique name, verifies identity and GATT services, then writes typed supported commands. Battery voltage is read from BA71 in the background for enrolled blinds. Position values are observations, not command acknowledgements. Two built-in simulators remain available for software development under the distinct names Somaris Simulator 1 and Somaris Simulator 2. Their positions and failure settings are independent, and simulated commands never use Bluetooth. Command and batch records are persisted in a bounded single-process journal. Browser preflights require exact HTTP or HTTPS origins from SOMARIS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS; the default allowlist is empty. Queue defaults are 1000 outstanding commands, 32 per device, one adapter operation at a time, and a 120-second queue wait. BLE scans use bounded windows and yield exclusive adapter access to GATT operations between windows. The control API has no authentication and is intended for a trusted network; CORS is not authentication. SOMARIS_DEMO_MODE is opt-in and creates a simulator-only demo. In demo mode, stateful device, simulator, command, batch, and activity API paths require the HttpOnly somaris-demo-session cookie returned by POST /api/demo/session. The cookie isolates visitor state; it is not authentication. Demo sessions are held in memory, expire after 30 minutes idle, are limited to 32 active sessions, and are lost on service restart. Demo mutations require a same-origin Origin header; CORS is not an access-control boundary.

post.summary: Enroll one uniquely named fresh Somaris V2 blind for control
post.description: Enrollment stores the advertised name and its opaque logical hash, never the current BLE address. The device name is re-read over GATT before every command. Duplicate active names are rejected. At most two simulators may be enrolled at once; a further simulator enrollment returns 409 with code simulator_limit_reached until one is removed. If the file rename succeeds but syncing its directory fails, the API returns 503 with code persistence_outcome_unknown; refresh the device list before retrying.

post.summary: Queue an open, close, stop, or percentage-position command
post.description: Commands are serialized per managed device and recheck freshness and identity before each physical attempt. set_position accepts position_closed_percent from 0 to 100, where 0 is fully open and 100 is fully closed. set_motor_speed accepts a percentage from 0 to 100. Endpoint calibration is an explicit sequence: start, nudge, set open/closed limits, then stop. Normal movement and motor-speed changes are blocked while calibration is active; use the Stop action to halt movement and calibration_stop to exit calibration. Calibration status is persisted with service state and an uncertain start remains locked until explicitly stopped. Adapter concurrency is bounded. Stop cancels queued movements and can preempt an in-flight movement only before its GATT write starts; after that the stop runs behind it. Queued commands expire after the configured queue wait timeout. On service restart, queued commands resume after a fresh observation; a command that was connecting is recovered as outcome_unknown and is never replayed. Physical commands receive at most one automatic retry after a confirmed connection or service-discovery failure before any GATT write. Between eligible attempts, Somaris yields adapter access to the scanner for one bounded scan window (about 1.3 seconds at the default) and then applies capped exponential backoff with deterministic jitter, increasing with recent confirmed pre-write failures. The next attempt rechecks advertisement freshness and identity. After four such failed attempts within ten minutes, movement requests are throttled for an increasing cooldown (15 seconds to 120 seconds); Stop remains available. Stop batches make one attempt for every target before retrying eligible pre-write failures. A Stop's first connection window is 12 seconds and its recovery window is 20 seconds; movement actions retain a 30-second connection window. A shared 45-second execution deadline covers each command's attempts, scan refresh, and backoff; queue wait has a separate timeout. After cancellation, Somaris allows up to 10 additional seconds for adapter cleanup before finalizing the command. If the execution deadline expires before a write, the command is connection_failed with error_code command_timeout and is safe to resubmit with a new idempotency key. If a write may have started, the outcome is outcome_unknown and must be checked against telemetry before retrying. Command attempts include phase timing and the advertisement age and RSSI used. Managed physical-device entries expose distinct advertisement, transport, and movement evidence; none is a live GATT probe. Movement feedback learns a per-blind rate from observed position samples and reports stalls without issuing corrective commands. Percentage targets use the V2 motor target characteristic and one-byte closed-percent payload. Motor speed uses the Shade Config characteristic. Calibration uses typed Motor Calibration and Motor Control writes. Simulated commands use the in-memory model and never invoke BlueZ.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Client-generated key persisted with the command. Repeating the same key and command returns the original record for up to 24 hours, subject to the bounded 1000-record journal retaining it. A different request with the same key returns 409. Use a new key for a new attempt after connection_failed. Commands are recorded durably before a 202 response.

429.description: Repeated confirmed pre-write failures have placed Open and Close requests in cooldown. Stop is exempt.

post.summary: Queue the opposite open or close action for one blind
post.description: Uses a fresh unique observation. When no newer command intent exists, target position below 50% closed is treated as open and target position at or above 50% closed is treated as closed; the command targets the opposite endpoint. A queued or connecting open/close command, or an acknowledged movement command not yet reflected in telemetry, supplies the effective target so rapid toggles reverse the latest intent. A pending stop or a possibly-sent movement command without a newer observation returns 409. The Command response includes toggle_basis, toggle_position, and toggle_observed_at to show the decision evidence. Unavailable, stale, or ambiguous positions also return 409. This is a state-changing POST and must not be invoked by GET links or prefetching clients. Retrying the same Idempotency-Key returns the original command and selected action.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Client-generated key persisted with the command. Repeating the same key and toggle returns the original record; a different request using that key returns 409.

post.summary: Queue an action for all currently ready enrolled blinds
post.description: The service snapshots enrolled blinds with a unique, fresh supported observation at acceptance. Enrollments that are not seen, stale, ambiguous, or in a movement cooldown are returned in skipped and do not count as failures; Stop batches bypass cooldown. The durable batch processes targets sequentially in label order. Stop batches cancel queued movement and preempt in-flight movement before its GATT write on every accepted target, reserve adapter access for the batch, make one attempt for each blind, then retry eligible confirmed pre-write failures. Each target rechecks identity and freshness before connecting and reports its ordinary child command status. A failed target does not prevent later targets from running. A batch is idempotent by its required Idempotency-Key; repeating that key with another action returns 409. A write_acknowledged child does not confirm physical movement. If no enrolled blind is eligible for the requested action, the request returns 409 no_available_blinds.

get.description: The batch record includes the accepted target snapshot, skipped enrollments, per-target child command IDs and statuses, and aggregate counts. Batches and their idempotency keys are kept in the bounded local journal; child command status can also be read from /api/control/v1/commands/{id}.

get.summary: Read the latest 30 changes and control outcomes
get.description: Returns the most recent enrollment changes, command outcomes, batch outcomes, and simulator changes, newest first. This bounded activity log is stored with persistent service state and does not require SOMARIS_HISTORY_PATH. Caller identity is not available because the control API has no authentication. In demo mode this activity belongs only to the cookie-scoped visitor session and is cleared by POST /api/demo/reset.

get.summary: Get the transport status for a command
get.description: Command records and idempotency keys are retained in the bounded local journal across service restarts. Completed records are retained for up to 24 hours, subject to the 1000-record cap. Queued commands resume after restart when the blind is observed again; a record recovered from connecting is outcome_unknown and is not replayed. write_state distinguishes not_sent, possibly_sent, and acknowledged. failure_stage and stable error_code identify where execution stopped; retryable means the caller may safely submit a new request. Raw Bluetooth or operating-system details are restricted to sanitized service logs.

get.summary: Read demo mode and simulator readiness
get.description: This service-level signal is available before demo session bootstrap. In normal mode demo_mode is false. simulator_ready describes simulated-device availability; bluetooth_adapter_ready reports adapter telemetry without implying a physical connection.

post.summary: Create or resume the current visitor demo session
post.description: Demo mode only. Reuses a valid cookie or creates an isolated in-memory session with four seeded blinds. The cookie is HttpOnly, SameSite=Strict, Secure over HTTPS, and scoped to Path=/. It is an isolation identifier, not user authentication. Bootstrap and state-changing demo requests require a same-origin Origin header.

200.description: The session is ready for dashboard API requests.

Set-Cookie.description: Opaque demo session cookie. Its server-side state expires after 30 minutes without activity.

404.description: Demo mode is disabled; this route is not registered in normal mode.

503.description: The bounded in-memory session store is at capacity.

204.description: Preflight accepted for a configured browser origin.

post.summary: Reset only the current visitor demo
post.description: Demo mode only. Cancels outstanding demo commands, restores the four seeded blinds and settings, and clears this session’s commands, batches, idempotency records, history, and activity. It cannot reach physical devices or another session. Requires a valid demo session cookie and same-origin Origin header.

200.description: The current session was restored to its seeded state.

NotModified.description: The semantic response data is unchanged. No body is returned.

ETag.description: Weak validator for semantic response data; send it in If-None-Match to receive 304 when unchanged.

ConditionalCacheControl.description: Responses can be stored and must be revalidated before reuse.

generated_at.description: UTC time at which this response was created.

simulator_ready.description: Whether simulated devices are configured and ready.

bluetooth_adapter_ready.description: Truthful adapter availability; false does not prevent demo readiness.

data.description: Service availability, simulator readiness, and truthful Bluetooth adapter readiness.

ScannerDiagnostics.description: Low-sensitivity runtime metrics. Raw system errors and BLE device identifiers are not returned.

last_advertisement_at.description: Most recent Somaris manufacturer advertisement received, including payloads that could not be decoded.

last_error_code.description: Stable code such as adapter_enable_failed, scan_ended, registry_store_failed, history_write_failed, scan_stop_timeout, or scan_stop_failed. Raw OS error details are never included.

retry_count.description: Number of retryable adapter or scan failures.

history_enabled.description: Whether persistent telemetry history is enabled.

demo_mode.description: Whether diagnostics belong to the isolated demo service.

simulator_ready.description: Whether simulated devices are configured and ready.

Position.description: Blind position in percent closed. The first reported position is current and the second is target; 0 is open and 100 is closed.

observed_at.description: UTC time of the observation that supplied these position values.

confidence.description: project_confirmed denotes protocol evidence; simulated denotes generated state.

BatteryTelemetry.description: Physical readings are cached BA71 GATT battery-voltage observations from enrolled blinds. This is not conventional Battery Service percentage data. Reads are performed in the background at a low frequency and are serialized with movement commands; GET requests do not connect to the blind. Percent is an estimate from the community-reference curve, not manufacturer-calibrated state of charge. The simulator can also return a synthetic replay of one captured sample; source identifies it as simulated. The physical cache is in memory and resets when the service restarts.

status.description: Whether the latest BA71 read succeeded, the characteristic is unsupported, the value was malformed, the latest read failed, or no read has been recorded. An unavailable status may include the last successful measurement. Unenrolled or currently ambiguous identities are not associated with cached readings.

voltage_mv.description: BA71 value decoded as little-endian u16 multiplied by 10 mV; present after a valid read and retained if a later read fails.

percent_estimate.description: Linear estimate from 0% at/below 3600 mV to 100% at/above 4100 mV; intermediate accuracy is uncalibrated. A last successful estimate is retained if a later read fails.

observed_at.description: UTC time of the latest successful BA71 read; retained if a later read fails.

last_attempt_at.description: UTC time of the latest background BA71 read attempt, whether it succeeded or failed; omitted until an attempt occurs.

error_code.description: Stable code for the latest unsuccessful read or invalid value. Raw BlueZ and D-Bus error messages are not exposed.

failure_stage.description: Stable service stage where the latest read failed, when available.

source.description: gatt_ba71 for a physical read; simulator for a synthetic scenario.

id.description: Opaque ID scoped to the current service process; it is not a permanent device identity.

logical_id.description: Optional stable opaque hash of a normalized advertised payload name. It is only unique when advertised names are unique and stable; duplicate names can collide.

observed_address.description: BLE address when the host platform exposes a usable value; it may be absent on privacy-preserving platforms and is never the enrollment identity.

advertised_name.description: Normalized physical payload name or the synthetic simulator name.

rssi_dbm.description: Received signal strength for physical observations. The simulator supplies a synthetic placeholder or capture-informed value, never a live motor measurement.

last_seen_at.description: UTC time of the latest physical advertisement or synthetic simulator observation.

freshness.description: Stale after the configured freshness interval (60 seconds by default).

source.description: Origin of the observation; simulated snapshots do not contain BLE evidence.

is_simulated.description: True only for the in-memory simulator device.

manufacturer_data_hex.description: Compatibility diagnostic field containing raw manufacturer bytes; prefer normalized telemetry.

manufacturer_payload_hex.description: Compatibility diagnostic field containing raw payload bytes; prefer normalized telemetry.

position_status.description: Explains whether position is available and why it may be null.

position.description: Decoded physical position or generated simulator state. Current-versus-target comparison describes reported direction only; it is not confirmation of physical motor movement.

MovementStatus.description: Derived from reported current and target positions. It does not confirm physical motion or acknowledge a command.

id.description: Opaque entry ID; command and batch entries use their operation ID.

occurred_at.description: When the change or operation was accepted.

subject.description: Device label or batch target summary.

target_closed_percent.description: Target requested by a set_position command.

status.description: Current or terminal command/batch status, when applicable.

detail.description: Short setting summary or batch skip summary.

completed_at.description: When an asynchronous command or batch reached a terminal state.

cursor.description: Increasing cursor used to page the retained history file; it can reset when no samples remain.

device_id.description: Runtime device ID used for this advertisement source.

logical_id.description: Optional stable opaque hash of a normalized advertised payload name.

id.description: Stable ID for this built-in simulator.

advertised_name.description: Distinct synthetic name included in the simulated SOMA V2 advertisement.

scenario.description: Scenario configured for this simulator only.

wireless_profile.description: The default hallway_observed profile uses the observed 80 ms connection and 72 ms write-response delays, one simulated position update per second (about 100 seconds for full travel), and capture-informed synthetic RSSI samples. hallway_slow_link uses the 702 ms maximum seen in six HCI connection samples and the same RSSI samples. standard has no transport delay and fixed -60 dBm synthetic RSSI.

battery_state.description: The default unavailable state retains a synthetic 4210 mV, 100% last-good sample and reports a later service-resolution failure, matching the observed Hallway cache. observed_sample replays a synthetic 4230 mV Hallway BA71 read, with a 100% estimate from an uncalibrated community curve.

position_closed_percent.description: Reset current and target positions to this value; 0 is open and 100 is closed. The default is the observed Hallway starting position, fully closed.

observed_device_id.description: Fresh runtime ID from GET /api/v1/devices. It is used only to confirm the enrollment target and is not persisted.

label.description: User-facing name for the managed blind.

id.description: Opaque managed-device ID. Demo IDs are scoped to the visitor session and held in memory.

advertised_name.description: Expected physical payload name or simulator name. The service verifies physical names with GATT and simulated names in memory.

logical_id.description: Opaque hash of the expected name in the physical or simulator namespace. Duplicate live names within a namespace are rejected.

is_simulated.description: True for an in-memory synthetic device; demo mode contains simulated devices only.

room.description: Optional room fixture label for a seeded demo blind.

ControlPosition.description: Latest observed BLE or generated simulator position. This is telemetry and does not confirm a command result.

availability.description: ready means a unique fresh physical or simulated observation is available; it does not mean the service is connected over GATT.

capabilities.description: Operations supported by Somaris for this managed device.

calibration_mode_active.description: True when Somaris has an active or uncertain calibration session; normal movement is blocked until calibration_stop is acknowledged. Calibration status is persisted with service state.

gatt_readiness.description: Present for physical enrollments. Historical status of the latest retained command and last retained acknowledged write; command records are kept for up to 24 hours subject to a 1000-record cap. It is not an active connection probe and does not confirm movement.

advertisement_age_ms.description: Age of the latest advertisement at response generation. A fresh observation does not prove GATT connection readiness.

movement_status.description: Derived from motor-reported current and target positions.

motion_feedback.description: Position-derived progress and a learned travel-rate estimate. It does not trigger automatic corrective commands.

requested_position_closed_percent.description: Latest retained movement command intent, including percentage-position requests; this is not motor telemetry.

requested_command_status.description: Transport lifecycle status for the latest retained command.

set_position.description: Whether this controller supports arbitrary V2 percentage positioning.

set_motor_speed.description: Whether this controller supports setting motor speed as a percentage; SOMA firmware 2.2.0 or later is required.

calibrate_endpoints.description: Whether this controller supports supervised endpoint calibration.

status.description: Outcome of the latest retained physical command. deferred means it was accepted before a cooldown opened but was held before any write. Acknowledged is historical evidence of a successful GATT response, not current reachability or movement.

transport_evidence.description: Interpretation of the latest retained command evidence. Advertisement availability is reported separately.

last_write_acknowledged_at.description: Most recent retained successful GATT write response, even if a later retained command failed.

failure_stage.description: Stable phase of the latest failed command.

error_code.description: Stable code for the latest failed or cancelled command.

cooldown_until.description: After repeated confirmed pre-write failures, Open and Close requests are temporarily throttled. Stop remains available.

status.description: Derived from motor position advertisements. Stall detection requires fresh position telemetry and never causes an automatic movement command.

estimated_travel_rate_percent_per_second.description: Median observed position rate from retained samples for this motor and target direction.

action.description: Open and close use the tested three-byte payloads. Stop uses the tested one-byte 00 payload. set_position writes one closed-percent byte to the V2 target characteristic. set_motor_speed writes a typed percentage through Shade Config. Calibration actions write fixed, typed command bytes to Motor Calibration or Motor Control. Arbitrary GATT writes are not exposed.

position_closed_percent.description: Required only for set_position. 0 is fully open; 100 is fully closed.

motor_speed_percent.description: Required only for set_motor_speed. This writes the motor speed setting; SOMA firmware 2.2.0 or later is required. The current setting is not read back by Somaris yet.

status.description: pending, a child Command status, or not_submitted.

id.description: Opaque command ID persisted in the local queue journal.

target_closed_percent.description: Target requested by a set_position command.

motor_speed_percent.description: Requested speed percentage for a set_motor_speed command.

toggle_basis.description: Present on toggle commands. observed_target means the action was selected from the reported target position; command_intent means it reversed a queued, connecting, or acknowledged movement command not yet reflected in telemetry.

toggle_position.description: Position snapshot present on toggle commands. It is telemetry, not confirmation of physical movement.

toggle_observed_at.description: Observation timestamp used for the toggle decision. Present on toggle commands.

queue_wait_ms.description: Time from acceptance until the command obtains serialized adapter access.

started_at.description: When the command began consuming adapter capacity.

completed_at.description: Completion time for terminal states, including expired and cancelled.

expires_at.description: Deadline after which a command still queued is marked expired.

attempts.description: Persisted records for each attempt, including its phase, duration, write state, and stable failure details.

error_code.description: Stable failure or cancellation code. preempted_by_stop means a queued or pre-write movement was cancelled by a later stop; command_timeout means the execution deadline expired before a write. Raw Bluetooth or operating-system errors are not exposed by the API.

failure_stage.description: Stable execution stage such as device_connection, service_resolution, gatt_discovery, identity_verification, gatt_write, command_deadline, or command_preempted.

write_state.description: Whether the command could have reached the blind. possibly_sent must be checked against telemetry before retrying.

retryable.description: True only when no GATT write was sent and a new request can be safely submitted.

duration_ms.description: Elapsed execution time in milliseconds, including an automatic retry when one was attempted.

phase.description: Last stable execution phase reached in this attempt; gatt_write_acknowledged marks a completed write response.

failure_cause.description: Stable connection setup cause when the operating system reports one. Raw host error text is not exposed.

adapter_scan_window_ms.description: Configured BLE adapter scan window in milliseconds. GATT operations take exclusive adapter access between scan windows.

command_execution_timeout_seconds.description: 45-second execution deadline after a command starts consuming adapter capacity. After Stop or deadline cancellation, adapter cleanup may take up to 10 additional seconds. Queue wait uses its separate configured timeout.

bluetooth_adapter_ready.description: Physical adapter telemetry; demo mode never claims adapter readiness.

idle_timeout_seconds.description: Idle time before this in-memory visitor session expires.

DemoSessionCookie.name: somaris-demo-session
DemoSessionCookie.description: Required for these stateful paths when SOMARIS_DEMO_MODE=true. Omitted in normal mode. The cookie isolates a demo context but is not authentication.
